patterns.note: Hero sections prominently feature oversized, central typography and a single, impactful product image, creating a strong visual focal point.
A highly stylized, rounded, and extremely bold display typeface is used for primary branding and large headings, often enhanced with a thick outline or stroke for a cartoonish effect.
A vibrant and limited color palette of dominant red, light beige, and yellow/orange accents is used for high contrast and to convey a playful, energetic brand identity.
The site utilizes a sticky header on interior pages and a persistent sticky cookie banner at the bottom of the viewport, ensuring key navigation and consent are always accessible.
Playful, hand-drawn style food illustrations are scattered throughout various content sections, acting as decorative visual anchors and reinforcing the site's energetic brand personality.

technique_notes: To create the primary headings and branding, use a custom, extremely bold and rounded display font, applying a thick stroke or outline effect to enhance its cartoonish quality and visual impact.
Implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport on interior pages, ensuring navigation links are consistently visible as the user scrolls.
Position a cookie consent banner as a sticky element at the bottom of the viewport, overlaying content without disrupting the main scroll flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, and rounded display headings (up to ~8x body text) with a thick stroke, contrasted by a clean, legible sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly rounded, especially for buttons, the cookie banner, and the character of the display typeface.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with ample whitespace around hero elements and product cards, creating a clean yet energetic presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an extremely bold, cartoonish display typeface with thick outlines, combined with playful, scattered food illustrations, creates a highly energetic and memorable brand identity that feels more like a comic book or animated short than a typical restaurant website.
